coverage_notes: Inventory built 2026-10-13 from Tier-1 sources only. STATE/FEDERAL: complete per Secretary of State Directive 2026-09 'Candidate Ballot Statement' (2026-09-03): US Senate, US House 1-6, Governor, 15 State Senate and 60 State House races, 7 circuit-court positions and 3 district-attorney races. No statewide measures and no statewide nonpartisan (e.g. BOLI) or appellate judicial contests are on the Nov 3 ballot per the same directive. PORTLAND METRO: Multnomah (official Ballot Content + RCV Ballot Content reports, 2026-09-22), Washington (county current-election page, city/SWCD certifications, voters' pamphlet) and Clackamas (county election page, filings, voters' pamphlet index) inventoried in full for county, city, SWCD, PUD, school and special-district contests and measures listed by those offices. No Metro (regional government) contests or measures appear on any of the three counties' November ballot lists. Washington/Clackamas legislative races are covered by the statewide SOS statement. REST OF STATE: only Marion County county-level races and Marion-filed measures were inventoried; Marion city races were NOT inventoried because the pamphlet's composite sample ballot text could not be reliably attributed to cities. All other counties' local races and measures (Lane, Deschutes, Jackson, Linn, Benton, etc.) are NOT inventoried. ZIP codes were left empty (no reliable official mapping read). Incumbency: set from oregonlegislature.gov rosters, Oregon Blue Book, portland.gov/council, multco.us/board, clackamas.us/bcc, judicial 'Incumbent' designations and city certification letters; null where no source read states it.
